scope: Project existing manually authored atlas correspondences through actual accepted141 triangle surfaces. No source-image feature extraction, remapping, geometry change or camera adoption.
limitations: The manual atlas correspondences approximate visible features. They are not independent anatomical measurements.
Rounded boundary controls within5e-6 UV of an existing vertex are reported explicitly with their UV offset; they are not triangle-interior hits.
A two-iris similarity removes global framing and roll only. Residuals can also reflect depth, yaw, hand placement and correspondence error.
